item.title: github: GitHub Enterprise Server support in the GitHub Copilot app
item.description:
GitHub Copilot app now supports GitHub Enterprise Server accounts. Users can add a GHES account to access remote repositories, issues, and pull requests from the app.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: GitHub Enterprise Server 3.22 is now generally available
item.description:
GitHub Enterprise Server 3.22 is generally available. The release adds new platform capabilities, including administrator configuration for Copilot CLI.

  • Source: GitHub
